comment: Hard constraints the caretaker's validator enforces, independent of any optimizer. Every value names its source. For the fictitious twin they come from the twin's interlocks (docs/datapoints.md) and the scenario. A real site must replace every value marked site_required from its design basis, commissioning and regulations (TEK17 13-1, NS-EN 16798-1/-3, the water-safety plan); none of them is a universal number.

setback_floor_c.source: caretaker design: deepest recoverable setback in the twin (ADR-007 Addendum 2)

frost_overlay_zone_c.source: caretaker design: frost floor + 4 K margin

tank_max_c.source: IL-04 (twin) less a 5 K high-pressure margin

iaq_overlay_co2_ppm.source: caretaker design: 50 ppm below the IL-07 ceiling

max_reading_jump_k_per_step.source: caretaker design: largest plausible change of a zone over 15 min in the twin

suspect_latch_s.source: caretaker design: a suspect sensor stays distrusted for at least 24 h and is escalated

recovery_hold_s.source: caretaker design: the recovery criterion (fresh again, or the reverse jump) must hold for 1 h

not_applicable.domestic_hot_water: The twin has no domestic hot water, so no water-safety overlay runs. A site with DHW must add one (FHI and Helsedirektoratet Legionella guidance; the site's water-safety plan) above every energy profile.
